subject: reactiveTable - passing arguments to xtable vs. print.xtable

messages.author: 55cb20da3fe82e18
messages.subject: reactiveTable - passing arguments to xtable vs. print.xtable
parts:
The documentation for reactiveTable(fun,...) passes any arguments besides the function to xtable; however, the xtable() function itself ignores additional arguments that are supported by print.xtable() like include.rownames. So you instead have to set global options like this:

  output$table <- reactiveTable(function() {
    options(xtable.include.rownames=FALSE)
    data.frame(x=data())
  })

Is there any particular reason to call just xtable and not print.xtable() which supports tons of options for customizing the output. 

Thanks

-Haider
